category_title: Disengaged ninth grader struggling with decoding and social anxiety
minimal_context: Harry is sitting with a tutor who is reading a text aloud while Harry is asked to follow along in his own book.
dialogue:
TUTOR: I am going to read this passage aloud now. Please follow along with the text in your book.

STUDENT: (Looks down at the page) Okay.

TUTOR: Are you keeping up with where I am reading?

STUDENT: No, I keep losing my place.

TUTOR: Just keep trying to follow the words.

STUDENT: I'm struggling to follow along with the words. Looking at the words is just becoming a distraction and leading to my inability to focus.

options.A: Provide noncontingent attention throughout the reading session and ignore the problem behaviors that function to gain attention.
options.B: Analyze the reading demand for reasons why the student escapes, and provide reinforcement for gradually increasing amounts of reading.
options.C: Develop a chart listing the date, time, reading activity, antecedent, behavior, consequence, and function of the incident.
options.D: Model how one reads and learns through teaching strategies in short time segments during the reading activity.
